summary: Sukhen Ghosh is an Indologist who earned a master's at Visva-Bharati University (2019-2021) and a Ph.D. at Mahatma Gandhi Central University (2022). In 2022, he served as a Research Scholar (SRF) at Mahatma Gandhi Central University.

Sukhlal Sanghvi (1880-1978) was an Indology and philosophy scholar. He studied at Shri Yashovijaya Jain Sanskrit Pathshala (1904) and under Balakrishna Mishra (1911). He held positions at Gujarat Vidyapith (1922), Banaras Hindu University (1934-1944), and Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan (1944).

Sukra Sagar Shrestha (1956-2018) worked in history, archaeology, and Indology. He served as an epigraphist at the Archaeological Survey of India (attested 1986) and at the Department of Archaeology (attested 1987).

Sukumar Sen (1900-1992) was a linguist and Indologist. Educated at Burdwan Raj College, Sanskrit College, and University of Calcutta under Suniti Kumar Chatterji and Irach Jehangir Sorabji Taraporewala, he later served as lecturer and Khaira Professor at Calcutta.

Sukumari Bhattacharji (1921-2014) was an Indology scholar who earned a master's in English from the University of Calcutta and a doctorate from Jadavpur University (~1960-1964). She taught English at Lady Brabourne College (1945) and was a teacher at Jadavpur University (1957-1986).
Sulagna Bhattacharya is an Indologist who studied under doctoral supervisor Pratap Bandyopadhyay. She held an H P Shastri Research Fellowship at The Asiatic Society (attested 2026).

Sulak Sivaraksa (born 1933) is a Buddhist and religious studies scholar educated at Assumption College, University of Wales, Lampeter, and the Social Science Research Council. He held visiting professorships at UC Berkeley, Toronto, Cornell, and Harvard, and founded several Buddhist organizations.

Suman Chakraborty works in computational fields and Indology. He studied at Presidency University, University of Calcutta, and IUCAA, later joining the faculty at the Indian Association for the Cultivation of Science (2019) and IIT Kharagpur (attested 2023).

Sumathi Ramaswamy (born 1961) is a historian and Indologist. She studied at the University of Delhi, Jawaharlal Nehru University, and the University of Pennsylvania, and later held academic posts at Pennsylvania (~1993-1995) and the University of Michigan (~2000-2007).

Sumi Lee is a Buddhist studies scholar. She earned an MA at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign under Alexander L. Mayer and completed a PhD at the University of California, Los Angeles, under the supervision of Robert E. Buswell Jr.

Sumitra Mangesh Katre (1906-1998) was an Indologist and linguist who completed a Ph.D. at the University of London under Ralph Lilley Turner. He taught at Sir Parashurambhau College, Deccan College Post-Graduate and Research Institute, and the University of Texas at Austin.

Sun-Ah Choi is a scholar of history, archaeology, and Buddhist studies. She earned her PhD from the University of Chicago under the doctoral supervision of Juhyung Rhi, also studying under Richard Neer, Robert S. Nelson, Jaś Elsner, and Aden Kumler.

Sunanda Mukhopadhyay is a scholar in linguistics and Indology who completed doctoral studies under Shyam Sundar Bhattacharya. Mukhopadhyay held a position as a Research Scholar / Fellow at The Asiatic Society (attested 2026).

Sunayana Maiti is an Indology and history/archaeology scholar who completed a Ph.D. at the University of Calcutta (2014-2021). She served as a Research Fellow in History of Science (2017-2021) and Research Scholar / Fellow (attested 2026) at The Asiatic Society.

Sung Yong Kang is a scholar of Indology and philosophy. He studied at Seoul National University and the University of Hamburg, and later held academic posts at Seoul National University (~2008) and the University of Vienna.

Sung-Bae Park (born 1933) is a Buddhist and religious studies scholar who earned a doctorate under Lewis Lancaster. He served as assistant professor at Dongguk University (~1967-1971) and became Professor Emeritus at Stony Brook University, where he began in 1977.
Sung-Eun Kim is a scholar of Buddhist and religious studies. Kim completed a PhD at Seoul National University (2004-2012) and became an assistant professor at Dongguk University in 2020.

Sungdoo Ahn is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology who completed a PhD at the University of Hamburg (-2001) under Lambert Schmithausen. Ahn has served as Director at Geumgang University and as a professor at Seoul National University (attested 2013).

Sungtaek Cho (born 1957) is a scholar of Buddhist studies and philosophy. Educated at Konkuk University and Korea University, he held posts at Stony Brook University, Korea University (including Director and Research Professor), and Gyeonggi Research Institute.
Sunhee Kim completed a Doctor of Philosophy in Performance Practice at the University of Exeter under the supervision of Phillip B. Zarrilli (attested 2013).
